en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a coastal town with wooden houses and a shoreline in the foreground. Two children sit on bare rock in the lower right. Behind them are fenced yards, small boats, and trees sloping down toward the sea. In the distance lies an island with a prominent square stone fortress tower surrounded by trees. The word "Kotka" is printed on the image, and publisher information appears along the bottom margin.
